historical_references.reference: The city of Taraz was a significant centre of the Umayyad Caliphate in Central Asia, particularly during the reign of Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik (724-743 AD). It was an important trade route hub and a major military stronghold.
historical_references.context: Centre of trade and military power

historical_references.reference: Taraz was also an important city in the Samanid Empire (819-999 AD), serving as the capital during the reign of Ismail Samani (892-907 AD). During this period, it was known for its cultural and intellectual achievements, particularly in the fields of mathematics, astronomy, and philosophy.
